$comment: Synthetic workflow qualification, not empirical calibration. Truth ln(1.2) is the previously declared small positive log correction. Mechanistic mu_max, Ks, Y, initial states and feeds are treated as exact. Noise settings and entire-experiment holdout come from synthetic_design.json. Only one alternative noise realization is fitted at a time. The explicit 1e-4 theta step is qualified by derivative refinement for this example, independent of the shared nonzero-step default. tol_fun=0 deliberately disables residual-norm termination for noisy data; gradient/step/budget criteria remain active. Replay budgets use the established handoff concentration budget and five forward-difference steps, not statistical confidence limits. LM does not enforce bounds; the existing provider rejects out-of-domain trials.
